Hi @Shirley Rellora, hope you are doing well.

Investigated TID 2607156788053355301 (store RB2-H042-TEX). This transaction comes through the Micros CD feed, not Simphony.

The "count only lines with a monetary value" logic (DO-9170) was signed off for Simphony Starbucks and Simphony CD only — "all other feeds to remain as-is." Micros CD was not in scope, so it still uses the previous rule (returns 4 instead of 1). Confirmed this matches the legacy behaviour, so it's working as originally agreed — not a defect.

Before making any change, please confirm:

  1. Was DO-9170 meant to apply to Micros CD too, or was it intentionally Simphony-only?

  2. If yes — Micros CD only, or also Micros SBX / other Micros feeds?

  3. Should it also cover Total Error Correct Count and Total Refund Count for the Micros feed(s)?

If confirmed, this is a new scope extension on top of DO-9170 rather than a bug fix, and we'll route it as such.

Best Regards,

Hi @Shirley Rellora,

Thanks — I want to make sure we're looking at the same value, because our stored data shows something different.

For the transaction in this ticket (ID 2607156788053355301, Micros), our Total Void Count is currently 4. That transaction has 6 voided lines, of which only 1 has a monetary value (Lamb Dinner). So today the count is including the zero-value voided lines (NO UPSELL, Fries, Chili Cup) — it is not counting only priced items.

Could you confirm exactly where you're seeing "only voided items with a monetary value are being counted" for Micros?

  • If you're looking at the Total Void Amount figure, that will naturally show only priced lines (a 0.000 line adds nothing to an amount) — but the Total Void Count beside it still includes the zero-value lines.

  • If you're seeing a count of only the priced voided items somewhere, please share that screen/report so we can trace which field it is.

This matters because it decides the next step: if Total Void Count should exclude zero-value voided lines for Micros (returning 1 here instead of 4), we can apply that logic — it's the same rule already used on the Simphony feeds. If Micros is fine as-is, we're good to close.

Thanks,
Diego Buelvas
Appriss Retail Support Team

","created":"2026-07-30T03:31:29.476-0400","updated":"2026-07-30T03:31:29.476-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"5fbbb452facfd60076d6c3e2","displayName":"Shirley Rellora"},"jsdPublic":true},{"id":"3258365","author":{"accountId":"712020:20065f69-a041-443a-8b58-b79b1649d0b4","displayName":"Diego Buelvas"},"body":"

Investigation Summary & Escalation to Delivery

Confirmed Issue

Transaction 2607156788053355301 (store `RB2-H042-TEX`, Micros CD feed) reports `x_totalvoidcount = 4`. Client confirmed on 2026-07-30 that this value is not as expected — the expected result is 1 (only voided lines with a monetary value should be counted).

Root Cause Findings

The counting logic in SnowTime applies two different filtering rules depending on the POS feed type:

Feed

Current Filter

Result for this transaction

Micros CD(`x_feedtype IN (1, 2)`)

Excludes non-merchandise lines (`nonmerchflg = FALSE`)

Counts 4 voided lines (1 priced + 3 zero-value non-nonmerch)

Simphony(`x_feedtype IN (4, 5)`)

Excludes zero-value lines (`amountcharged != 0`)

Would count 1 (priced only)

The transaction has 6 voided lines. Only 1 (Lamb Dinner) carries a monetary value. The remaining 5 break down as:

  • 2 excluded by `nonmerchflg` (Medium / AS APP)

  • 3 zero-value lines that pass the `nonmerchflg` filter (NO UPSELL, Fries, Chili Cup) — these 3 are currently counted, giving total = 4

This behavior is consistent with legacy pyardm (validated across 798 Micros CD transactions — 100% match on the nonmerch rule). SnowTime replicates the original logic faithfully.

The monetary filter (`amountcharged != 0`) was introduced via DO-9170 but its signed scope covered Simphony feeds only. Micros CD was explicitly excluded — "all other feeds to remain as-is."

Client Clarification Timeline

  • 2026-07-28 — Client stated: "I did NOT raise any issue with the void count for Micros because the logic appears correct." This referenced a POS receipt (ticket 5836) showing Total Void Amount — which naturally excludes zero-value lines — rather than Total Void Count.

  • 2026-07-30 — Client confirmed: "the 2607156788053355301 is not as expected", pointing to their July 28 comment as the reference expectation.

Disambiguation resolved: the client wants the monetary filter (`amountcharged != 0`) applied to Micros CD.

Proposed Fix

Extend the monetary filter to Micros CD in the client fastfact model.

File: `dbt/clients/eu/c125_ala/models/fastfact/ff_ardm_header_items.sql`

Current (line 283):

sql

WHEN voidedflg = TRUE AND cancelflg = FALSE

     AND x_feedtype IN (1, 2) AND COALESCE(nonmerchflg, FALSE) = FALSE

THEN ABS(numberofitems)

Proposed:

sql

WHEN voidedflg = TRUE AND cancelflg = FALSE

     AND x_feedtype IN (1, 2) AND COALESCE(nonmerchflg, FALSE) = FALSE

     AND amountcharged != 0

THEN ABS(numberofitems)

The same filter must be applied consistently to `x_totalerrorcorrectcount` (lines 293–294) and `x_totalreturncount` (lines 314–315) in the same file.

Expected outcome after fix: `x_totalvoidcount` for TID `2607156788053355301` = 1.

> Note: This is not a SnowTime bug — SnowTime replicates pyardm exactly. This is a scope extension of DO-9170 to the Micros CD feed, applied at the client level. No framework files (`snowtimeV2/`, `snowtimeBase/`) are modified.

Escalation: Delivery Team

Escalating to Delivery for the following reasons:

  1. The fix requires modifying a client-specific dbt model (`c125_ala`), which is within Delivery's scope of client pipeline maintenance.

  1. After the fix, a dbt rebuild and re-validation against production is required (`dbt build --select +ff_ardm_header_items+`), followed by a historical backfill review — `c125_ala` has `historical_transaction_id_enabled = true`.

  1. This is not a platform defect, UI issue, or framework regression. It is a data transformation logic extension for a single client, confirmed by the client on 2026-07-30.

Hi Shirley,

Thank you for your patience while we worked through this.

We've implemented the fix to extend the monetary-value filter to the Micros CD/SBX feeds — going forward, zero-value voided, error-corrected, and returned lines (e.g. modifier lines like "NO UPSELL") will no longer be counted in Total Void Count, Total Error Correct Count, and Total Return Count for those feeds, matching the behaviour already in place on the Simphony feeds.

The change has been validated in our lab environment and is now going through our standard review and deployment process.

Please note that individual transactions can be affected by more than one factor, so the exact count on any single receipt may not always match a manual line-by-line count — if anything looks off once this is live, let us know the transaction ID and we'll take a look.

We'll follow up here once the fix is deployed.

Kind regards,
Nikita Rathore

Thank you for your patience.

The fix has been deployed to production. This is a going-forward change — from now on, zero-value voided, error-corrected, and returned lines (e.g. modifier lines like "NO UPSELL") will no longer be counted in Total Void Count, Total Error Correct Count, and Total Return Count for the Micros CD/SBX feeds, matching the behaviour already in place for Simphony.

Please note this does not retroactively recalculate historical transactions already loaded — including the example transaction referenced in this ticket, so re-checking that specific transaction won't show a different count. The corrected logic applies only to transactions processed from this point forward.

Kind regards,
Nikita Rathore

Hi Shirley,

Thank you for your patience while we investigated.

We've confirmed the fix for the Micros CD/SBX void count and amount issue is live in production as of today, and we've validated it directly against your data. The root cause was in how void lines were being identified for Micros feeds — the original logic was tagging the wrong line (the void-reversal record) instead of the original sale line, which meant the void count/amount rollups could never pick it up. That's now corrected.

This is a going-forward change: it applies to transactions processed from today onward. It does not retroactively recalculate historical transactions already loaded, so re-checking older receipts won't show updated counts — only new transactions from today forward will reflect the corrected void count and amount.

Please let us know if you continue to see the issue on Micros CD/SBX transactions going forward, and we'll be happy to take another look.

Kind regards,
Nikita Rathore
